cand.title: 85th National Congress of Pneumology and Thoracic Surgery 2027
cand.organizationName: Sociedad Mexicana de Neumología y Cirugía de Tórax

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Mariana Peñaloza is the named society operations contact, reachable through operaciones@smnyct.org; the congress identifies that mailbox as Dirección Operativa. She is the strongest named operational routing candidate. Dra. Catalina Casillas Suárez is the society president named in the 2027 congress welcome and board; relevant as executive relationship sponsor, not a verified accommodation buyer. Neither person is proven to hold hotel-contract signature authority. BTC is the published accommodation intermediary, but no named 2027 housing account manager was verified.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming, in-person 85th edition: 9–13 March 2027, Expo Guadalajara, Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico. These are activity dates explicitly published by both the society and congress website, not article dates. Within the requested horizon. No verified 2028 edition dates or destination found.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel profile: a full-service, Expo-area city hotel with guestrooms and meeting facilities fits this five-day scientific congress better than a resort-led proposition, because the confirmed programme is at Expo Guadalajara and the organizer already markets Sheraton Guadalajara Expo for accommodation. Primary thesis: activate existing delegate, faculty and exhibitor lodging access. Private meetings or meals are secondary proposals only; no 2027 off-site meeting requirement is published. Do not assume the hotel can host the entire congress or convert its 216 rooms into an event block.
findings.venueCommitments: Expo Guadalajara is the published official congress venue; no venue contract was inspected. Sheraton Guadalajara Expo is already an officially listed accommodation option and appears in the congress-linked reservation portal. This is evidence of an established accommodation channel, not proof of a contracted room allotment, guaranteed production or open supplier procurement.
findings.historicalRotation: Documented editions: 81st, Veracruz/Boca del Río, 13–17 June 2023; 82nd, Puebla, 13–17 March 2024; 83rd, Acapulco, 11–15 March 2025; 84th, Cancún, 10–14 March 2026; 85th, Guadalajara, 9–13 March 2027. The society explicitly moved the planned 2024 Acapulco edition to Puebla after Hurricane Otis and deferred Acapulco to 2025. This establishes recurring, rotating destinations, not a fixed Guadalajara annual event or a known return cycle.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Status: hotel sourcing unconfirmed; attendee accommodation marketing/reservations are already established. The official site links to CheckMeIn housing and publishes hospedajesmnyct2027@btcamericas.com, +52 55 5200 5100 ext. 17528. The portal repeats that email but gives extensions 17354/17309. Use the shared email to resolve routing. The portal displays Sheraton Guadalajara Expo at MXN 2,949.14; rate basis, applicable dates, room type, taxes and live inventory require confirmation before quoting. No published block quantity, pickup, cutoff, RFP or invitation for additional hotel suppliers was found.
findings.organizationStructure: The event is organized by the professional medical society Sociedad Mexicana de Neumología y Cirugía de Tórax, with its own board and operations/commercial directorates. It is not an event owned by Expo Guadalajara or a hotel. BTC Americas is evidenced as the accommodation intermediary through the event-specific housing email; an INCON case study identifies BTC as organizer for the historical 81st congress. Do not extend that historical mandate into an unverified exclusive 2027 full-service PCO contract.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Seven official accommodation options are published: Barceló Guadalajara, Fiesta Inn Guadalajara Expo, Ibis Guadalajara Expo, Sheraton Guadalajara Expo, Voco Guadalajara Expo, City Express Plus and The Westin Guadalajara. The official accommodation page marks Barceló and Westin “Sin Disponibilidad”; the portal nevertheless still displays a Westin price. Treat this as channel-level availability information requiring reconfirmation, not proof that either hotel is wholly sold out. No documented overflow referral, displacement, unmet room quantity or guaranteed Sheraton pickup was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First reconcile the existing 2027 listing with the hotel sales/revenue team, then email the published BTC housing desk and Mariana Peñaloza. Ask who manages the Sheraton allotment and hotel contract, and confirm whether the listing is an active agreement or referral channel, stay dates, allotment, pickup, release/cutoff, rates/taxes and whether additional rooms are wanted. Offer a factual inventory update, not an unsolicited replacement-venue bid. Ask the society commercial directorate about permitted introductions for faculty/exhibitor lodging and small private meetings; do not imply demand already exists. Request future host-selection timing only after establishing the current account owner.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The next/currently marketed edition is March 2027, not the expired 2026 congress. Sheraton already appears in the official accommodation programme and linked reservation portal, making account servicing and potential pickup activation more relevant than a cold venue-capture pitch. Procurement access and incremental inventory acceptance remain unknown. Expo is already selected for the main event.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: use 2027 delivery and the SMNyCT/BTC relationship to position Sheraton for later Guadalajara editions or relevant smaller groups. The documented destination rotation supports relationship development but does not establish a 2028 Guadalajara opportunity, an open future bid, or a scheduled return. No 2028 dates, venue or selection timetable were verified.
